defs.def: a movement that you make with your hands, your head or your face to show a particular meaning 手势；姿势；示意动作

ex.s: In fact, this is similar to the gestures we use when we speak.
ex.t: 事实上，这与我们说话时使用的手势类似。

ex.s: You might want to: • relax and make eye contact with the audience • use gestures when appropriate • vary your tone and volume 1 Select a representative from the group to deliver the speech to the class.
ex.t: 你或许想要：• 放松并与听众保持眼神交流 • 在适当的时候使用手势 • 变换你的语调和音量 1 从小组中选一名代表向全班发表演讲。

ex.s: They should pay attention to their facial expressions, gestures, intonation, and actions.
ex.t: 他们应该注意自己的面部表情、手势、语调和动作。

ex.s: The gesture for “OK” has different meanings in different cultures.
ex.t: OK的手势在不同文化中有不同的含义。

ex.s: In Japan, someone who witnesses another person employing the gesture might think it means money.
ex.t: 在日本，如果看到别人做出这个手势，可能会以为那代表钱。

defs.def: something that you do or say to show a particular feeling or intention （表明感情或意图的）姿态，表示
